title: Piccoli
identity: Léon Jongen’s Piccoli is a two-movement alto saxophone and piano work; an institutional library catalog describes the score as for cello or alto saxophone and piano. A dissertation gives the movement labels “Pseudo vals” and “Pseudo rag” and dates it 1931.

evidence.claim: Royal Conservatoire Antwerp library catalog identifies Piccoli for cello or E-flat alto saxophone and piano, with dedication to Maurice Dambois.
UPV dissertation describes the saxophone/piano version, 1931 date and two movement labels.
Dorn/Andel catalog lead identifies publisher code ANDEL07 and 20 pages.

review_focus: Inference: the dissertation’s ragtime description for the second movement supports checking its rhythmic articulation and style against the preceding pseudo-waltz.
collection_flag: The institutional catalog lists cello or E-flat alto saxophone with piano. This establishes an alternate-instrument edition, but not which instrument was original.
gaps: Exact publisher imprint and instrument provenance remain unverified in a primary catalog.
proposed_corrections: Qualify saxophone edition as an alternative to cello, according to institutional library catalog.
